name: CT Volume QC & Segmentation Ensemble
description: Evaluates raw voxel distributions, runs multi-threshold parameter sweeps (Otsu, Phansalkar), and flags image artifacts (ring/beam hardening).

name: CT-Only Skeleton Graph & Strut-Node Recovery
description: Converts 3D binary voxels into a 1D centerline graph (networkx), extracting branch nodes, degree, and edge connectivity without CAD.

name: Strut & Node Morphometry / Equivalent Diameter
description: Calculates local thickness via Euclidean distance transform along 3D centerlines to compute equivalent strut diameters.
